messages:
Priya (AE): FYI Lumen asked if we can run a POC with a custom model variant they call `lumina-3b-q5`. They want perf numbers, KV cache compatibility, and a pricing sketch for mixed quantized variants. any immediate blockers?
Zoe (Solutions): pinging infra + ml. do we have a checklist for custom model onboarding? seq lengths + tokenizer details are first things i need.
Marco (Eng-Infra): quick note — our runtime already loads q5-style quantized weights but there are caveats: KV cache serialization had intermittent tail latency spikes >8k seq. we should validate with their typical prompts. also need model config (dim, vocab, rotary params).
Ben (Eng-ML): can we get a sample model.tar or at least a metadata.json + tokenizer? if it's a GPT-like arch fine, but q5 can change logits scaling. performance estimate: on rtx-a5000-ish single-GPU we should see ~15-20 tok/s for 3B with batching=8, but bench after we get weights. recommend doing a short local run with `--quant-profile=q5` to catch dequantization drift.
Priya (AE): noted. i'll ask Lumen for a minimal bundle and a representative prompt set (typical seq length ~600, some at 2k).
Raj (Security): licence + data flow Qs — what is the model license? will they upload unredacted customer data for fine-tuning during the POC? if so, we need to enable KMS + customer-managed keys and update the privacy sheet. also need to know if model contains any third-party weights flagged by SPDX or non-commercial clauses.
Alice (Product): product question — will this be hosted on Redwood Hosted or Dedicated? that changes rollout options and pricing a lot. if they want dedicated we can reserve capacity but need a 30-day lead for GPU pool.
Olivia (Acct Exec): for budget framing — if Hosted, rough POC estimate = $2k-$6k depending on token volume. Dedicated short-term reservation (1mo) starts ~ $25k+ depending on GPUs. exact quote after we know throughput needs.
Zoe (Solutions): small ops ask for the POC: 1) model bundle (weights + tokenizer + config), 2) example prompt set + golden responses (for quality check), 3) expected concurrency and p95 latency SLO.
Priya (AE): i'll gather bundle + prompts and ask them which deployment mode they prefer. scheduling: can we do a technical kickoff tomorrow 10am PT?
Marco (Eng-Infra): 10am PT works. i'll create a quick internal runbook for `lumina-3b-q5` verification: load -> tokenization sanity -> KV cache stress (2k seq, concurrent 8) -> perf profile -> fallback policy (auto-switch to float16 variant).
Ben (Eng-ML): add a unit test to eval harness: `tests/quant_regress/lumina_q5_smoke.py` that runs 10 prompts and checks output similarity > 0.92 to baseline.
Raj (Security): i'll start a security intake: need model license file + TOC for any model provenance, and confirmation that customer data won't be stored outside the POC bucket. if they insist on SSO + audit logs, note that Dedicated/Private is recommended.
Olivia (Acct Exec): Priya — if they ask for a trimmed quote for procurement doc, i've got a stub. i can drop a Hosted POC line item and a Dedicated reserve line.
Priya (AE): thanks all. i'll collect the items and send Lumen a single checklist + calendar invite.
RedwoodBot: Ticket created: #POC-4519 for Lumen lumina-3b-q5 onboarding (assignee: Zoe).
Zoe (Solutions): thx — i'll own the onboarding run. once i get the bundle i'll do a quick `redwoodctl model scan` and post results here.
Marco (Eng-Infra): example command i'll run: ```
redwoodctl model scan ./lumina_bundle.tar --profile q5 --kv-check --seq 2048
```
Ben (Eng-ML): if they send multiple quant variants we should test both: q5 vs q8 and compare token-level perf + logit drift. small table in the POC report should help procurement decide.
Priya (AE): putting next steps in the invite. 🎯
Olivia (Acct Exec): :thumbsup: will prep pricing stub.
Raj (Security): keep me cc'd on bundle and license.
Priya (AE): last note — Lumen also asked about latency SLA for production. we'll keep that separate but want to ensure POC shows we can meet p95 < 350ms for their typical prompt (600 tokens).
